name: Non-existent service account
description: A workload that explicitly references a ServiceAccount which does not exist in the same namespace will fail to schedule. This control detects such misconfigurations before they cause runtime errors.
remediation: Create the referenced ServiceAccount in the workload namespace, update serviceAccountName to an existing ServiceAccount, or remove the explicit serviceAccountName if the workload should use the default service account.
test: Check that workloads referencing a ServiceAccount by name have a matching ServiceAccount object in the same namespace.
